title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Underwriting Bulletin: Owned-Property Account Factor for Residential Placements
content:
**Rule.** For a new placement priced under the residential placement schedule of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** (Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier), the rated amount of a new placement is multiplied by 0.92 when the premium payments the lender made in the last 12 months on its own NFIP Dwelling Form policies with Tidemark total 10000 dollars or more and the program has been in force 24 months or more; by 0.96 when those payments total 3000 dollars or more and the program has been in force 12 months or more, but the payments are below 10000 dollars or the program has been in force fewer than 24 months; and by 1.00 in every other case.

**Records read.** The payments are the lender's own premium payments received on the policies it holds as insured under the NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — the payment entries on those policies' accounts, dated by the day each payment was received. The program's months in force run from its program effective date.

**Counting.** Months in force for a new placement are the whole calendar months from the program effective date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached. A window of the last 12 months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than 12 such whole months have passed by today.

## Truth table

| Own NFIP Dwelling Form payments, last 12 months | Program in force | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 10000 dollars or more | 24 months or more | 0.92 |
| 10000 dollars or more | 12 to 23 months | 0.96 |
| 3000 to below 10000 dollars | 12 months or more | 0.96 |
| 3000 dollars or more | fewer than 12 months | 1.00 |
| below 3000 dollars | any | 1.00 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A lender's program took effect on the 20th of a month exactly two years before today's date, which is also the 20th: 24 whole months have passed, so with 10000 dollars or more of own payments the multiplier is 0.92. Had today been the 19th, only 23 months would count, giving 0.96 where the payments are at least 3000 dollars.
- A lender holds no NFIP Dwelling Form policy with Tidemark: its payments total zero and the multiplier is 1.00.
